description:
Support applications for Myriad Playout v6, including Remote Edit Server, AutoImporter, OCP and Backup

Myriad Playout Support Applications v6 bundles the supporting tools for Myriad Playout: the Remote Edit Server, the AutoImporter for automated media import, the On-Air Client Panel (OCP), and the backup utility.
Myriad Remote Edit Server Changes:
New Features/Changes:
Smart Info:
- Traffic: The new National Highways traffic provider can now also show TFL status information. You turn this on via a new checkbox on the Station Settings window.
- Traffic: The National Highways traffic provider has been updated to reduce the number of calls made to the National Highways servers.
The following issues have been fixed:
- Myriad Remote Edit Server: Fixed an issue where the Myriad Anywhere Tunnel might take longer to reconnect to the Myriad Anywhere Cloud if the internet connection was briefly lost. In some circumstances you would need to manually restart the Myriad Anywhere Service.
- Update Media Wizard: Attributes could not be updated in stations other than Station 0 if the database was set to use Shared Attributes.
